actions.stopFirst.detail.defaultMessage: It will be stopped first. Its conversation is kept and can be resumed from the Sessions tab.
actions.stopFirst.detail.description: Under the question before replacing or removing a running session.

actions.stopFirst.message.description: The question before replacing or removing a running session: the project ({project}) and, when it has several agents, the agent in brackets ({agent}: " (B1)", or empty).

actions.stopFirst.title.defaultMessage: {what, select, new {Start a new session?} resume {Resume this session?} other {Remove {agent}?}}
actions.stopFirst.title.description: Title of the question before starting a new session (new), resuming one (resume) or removing an agent ({agent}; other) while it runs.

actions.template.addAgentFailed.description: An error's title: adding an agent from a template failed.

actions.template.blockedMessage.defaultMessage: It can't be loaded into {project, select, none {this project} other {{project}}} yet:
actions.template.blockedMessage.description: Above the reasons a template can't be loaded into a project ({project}; none when unknown).

actions.template.blockedTitle.description: Title of the message when a template ({name}) can't be loaded now (an agent runs, a provider is off…).

actions.template.everyProject.defaultMessage: For every project in the workspace (else for this project only)
actions.template.everyProject.description: A tick box in the Save as Template dialog: the template is the workspace's (ticked) or this project's.

actions.template.load.description: Button: loads the template into the project.

actions.template.loadAdds.description: The question before loading a template into a project ({project}) with no agents.

actions.template.loadReplaces.description: The question before loading a template: its agents replace every agent of the project ({project}).

actions.template.loadTitle.description: Title of the question before loading a template ({name}) into a project.

actions.template.loading.description: The Load template button while it works.

actions.template.nameEmpty.description: Why a template's name can't be used: it is empty.

actions.template.namePlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the Save as Template dialog's name box.

actions.template.nameTooLong.description: Why a template's name can't be used: it is longer than {max} characters.

actions.template.noAgents.description: A notification's title: the project has no agents to save as a template.

actions.template.noAgentsMessage.defaultMessage: Add the agents first, then save them as a template.
actions.template.noAgentsMessage.description: Under the notification that there are no agents to save as a template.

actions.template.ok.description: Button: closes the message that a template can't be loaded yet.

actions.template.openSetup.description: Button: opens Agent Setup (a Help window) to install a missing CLI.

actions.template.providerOff.defaultMessage: A provider it needs is turned off
actions.template.providerOff.description: A warning's title: a template needs a CLI that is turned off.

actions.template.providerOffMessage.defaultMessage: Turn it on in Settings → Providers, then load the template again.
actions.template.providerOffMessage.description: Under the warning that a template needs a CLI that is turned off. Settings → Providers is where: use its translated names.

actions.template.readFailed.description: An error's title: reading a template failed.

actions.template.removeOld.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {Also remove the old worktree and its branch} other {Also remove # old worktrees and their branches}} (merged into {into, select, none {the main branch} other {{into}}} and clean): {branches}
actions.template.removeOld.description: A tick box when loading a template: also delete the replaced agents' {n} worktrees and branches that are merged into a branch ({into}; none when it isn't known) and have no changes. {branches} lists them.

actions.template.replace.description: Button: replaces the template of that name.

actions.template.replaceDetail.defaultMessage: Saving replaces it with these agents and this layout.
actions.template.replaceDetail.description: Under the question when a template of that name exists.

actions.template.replaceMessage.defaultMessage: {scope, select, workspace {The workspace already has a template called "{name}".} other {This project already has a template called "{name}".}}
actions.template.replaceMessage.description: The question when the workspace's (workspace) or this project's (other) templates already have one called {name}.

actions.template.replaceTitle.description: Title of the question when a template of that name exists.

actions.template.reusedMessage.defaultMessage: {branch} in {path}: it was clean, and its branch is left as it is.
actions.template.reusedMessage.description: Under the notification that an agent works in its old worktree again: its branch ({branch}) and folder ({path}).

actions.template.reusedTitle.description: A notification's title: an agent added from a template ({agent}) works in the clean worktree it had before.

actions.template.saveFailed.description: An error's title: saving a template failed.

actions.template.saveMessage.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {Its agent} other {Its # agents}} (settings and roles) and the layout, to load into any project later. Sessions and worktrees aren't saved.
actions.template.saveMessage.description: The Save as Template dialog: what a template keeps of the project's {n} agents.

actions.template.saveTitle.description: Title of the Save as Template dialog.

actions.template.saved.description: A notification's title: the template was saved.

actions.template.savedMessage.defaultMessage: "{name}" ({n, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}}), for {scope, select, workspace {the workspace} other {this project}}.
actions.template.savedMessage.description: Under the notification that a template ({name}) of {n} agents was saved for the workspace (workspace) or this project (other).

actions.unsaved.changedMessage.defaultMessage: Save them, then {action, select, switch {switch workspace} close {close the workspace} other {reload the window}} again.
actions.unsaved.changedMessage.description: Under the warning that files changed while they were saved: what to do (switch: switching workspace; close: closing it; other: reloading the window).

actions.unsaved.changedTitle.defaultMessage: Some files changed while they were being saved
actions.unsaved.changedTitle.description: A warning's title: files were edited again while Save All saved them.

actions.unsaved.message.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {{file} has unsaved changes. Save it before you {action, select, switch {switch workspace} close {close the workspace} other {reload the window}}?} other {# files have unsaved changes. Save them before you {action, select, switch {switch workspace} close {close the workspace} other {reload the window}}?}}
actions.unsaved.message.description: The question before switching workspace (switch), closing the workspace (close) or reloading the window (other) while {n} files have unsaved changes; {file} is the one file's path when there is one.

actions.unsaved.saveAll.description: Button: saves every file with unsaved changes, then goes on.

actions.unsaved.saveFailed.defaultMessage: Couldn't save {n, plural, one {a file} other {# files}}
actions.unsaved.saveFailed.description: An error's title: saving files before switching or closing the workspace failed for {n} of them.

actions.unsaved.title.description: Title of the question before switching or closing the workspace, or reloading the window, while files have unsaved changes.

actions.workspace.closeFailed.description: An error's title: closing the workspace failed.

actions.workspace.createFailed.description: An error's title: creating a workspace failed.

actions.workspace.openFailed.description: An error's title: opening a workspace failed.

actions.worktree.createFailed.description: An error's title: making an agent's worktree again failed.

actions.worktree.createNew.description: Button: makes a new worktree for the agent.

actions.worktree.goneDetail.defaultMessage: {setup} If the workspace moved, Repair… in its banner can also locate the folder.
actions.worktree.goneDetail.description: Under the question when a worktree agent's folder and branch are gone: {setup} is what making it again involves; Repair… is a button in the workspace's banner.

actions.worktree.goneMessage.defaultMessage: {agent}'s worktree folder is missing ({path}), and its branch {branch} is gone too. Create a new worktree on {branch} from {base}, or remove the agent's worktree link so it works in the project folder?
actions.worktree.goneMessage.description: The question when a worktree agent's ({agent}) folder ({path}) and git branch ({branch}) are gone: make a new worktree on that branch from {base}, or have the agent work in the project folder.

actions.worktree.goneTitle.description: Title of the question when a worktree agent's folder and branch are both gone.

actions.worktree.recreate.description: Button: makes the agent's worktree again on its branch and starts the agent.

actions.worktree.recreateMessage.defaultMessage: {agent}'s worktree folder is missing: {path}. Its branch {branch} is still in the repository: recreate the worktree on it, with its commits, and start?
actions.worktree.recreateMessage.description: The question when a worktree agent's ({agent}) folder ({path}) is missing but its git branch ({branch}) is there.

actions.worktree.recreateTitle.description: Title of the question when a worktree agent's folder is missing but its branch is there.

actions.worktree.recreating.description: The Recreate and Start button while it works.

actions.worktree.setup.defaultMessage: Hive copies in the files it copies into new worktrees, and the project's worktree setup command, if it has one, runs before the agent starts. Nothing is deleted.
actions.worktree.setup.description: Under the question before recreating an agent's missing worktree: what making it again involves.

actions.worktree.unlink.description: Button: the agent works in the project folder from now on.

actions.worktree.unlinkFailed.defaultMessage: Could not remove the worktree link
actions.worktree.unlinkFailed.description: An error's title: removing an agent's worktree link failed.
